abstract: Two patients with a trophoblastic tumour (one with an invasive mole and one with a choriocarcinoma) had early pregnancy factor (EPF; detected by rosette inhibition test) in serum. In both cases the EPF already disappeared during surgery which suggests that EPF could be a useful and sensitive tumour marker if laboratory technology for its detection could be improved.
abstract_ja: 2例の栄養膜腫瘍患者(侵入奇胎1例および絨毛癌1例)において、血清中の早期妊娠因子(EPF;ロゼット阻止試験で検出)が認められた。両例とも手術中にEPFはすでに消失しており、その検出のための検査技術が改善されれば、EPFは有用で感度の高い腫瘍マーカーとなりうることが示唆される。
